subject: science
concept: Observing that friction slows down or stops moving objects
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Physical Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Forces and Motion) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student rolls an object across different real or virtual surfaces (smooth vs. rough) and compares how far it travels
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a surface type to how much it would slow an object down
exercise.abstract: Student predicts which of two described surfaces would create more friction

misconception_flags: assumes all surfaces create the same amount of friction regardless of texture

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
